rejected_rule.statement: An action to set aside a deed of gift executed by a deceased person, without obtaining letters of administration if the property is included in the estate requiring administration, is maintainable under section 547 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "The action was not one for the 'recovery' of any property belonging to the deceased. ... That view is in accordance with the decision in Lewishamy v. De Silva[ 3 (1906) 3 Balasingham 43.,] and the ruling of the District Judge on the first issue was right."
